news.body:
Welcome to the September 2026 edition of AppleVis Unlimited, your monthly digest of the latest and most notable content on the AppleVis website. This newsletter features a curated selection of community-submitted content, including new app entries, updates, news, podcast episodes, and popular discussions. We hope that you find this publication to be both helpful and informative. If you have any questions or feedback about this newsletter, please feel free to reach out using our Contact Form .

Restaurant Rush is a simulation game that puts you in charge of your very own restaurant: preparing orders, serving customers (before they lose patience), earning coins, upgrading your kitchen, and building your way to different restaurants. With a 100-day campaign, Endless mode, more than 50 recipes, kitchen upgrades, and waitstaff to hire (and more), there is plenty here to keep you busy. And all of it comes from a developer who is passionate about accessibility and engagement with our community.

Read more about Restaurant Rush here.

From the App Store:

New here? Challenge a friend, answer whenever you wish, and let the sharpest mind win. Multiple categories, and a daily reward waiting for you.

Brainclash is a quiz game with a different rhythm: a refined battle of minds you take on in your own time, with no pressure. Challenge a friend to a match, let the game pair you with a random opponent, or train first against the computer. Play unfolds turn by turn: you answer, then your opponent answers, and the most accurate one wins. There's no tense timer forcing you both online at the same moment — take your turn whenever you like, and return for the next one anytime.

Additional Details:

From the App Store:

Dive into the exciting world of Boba Sort Cafe! Solve charming tea & coffee sorting puzzles to relax, challenge yourself, and explore the world. This isn't just a game; it's a journey to build your global Boba Tea empire.

Additional Details:

From the App Store:

Chess you already know. An army you have to raise.

Chess Meets Necromancy is a turn-based roguelike played on a real chessboard with real chess movement. Your hero is one piece. Everything you capture is a corpse you can raise.

Additional Details:

From the App Store:

Keep useful text, links, formatting and images close at hand, with accessible local history and optional encrypted synchronization through your own Clipman Server.

Clipman is an accessible clipboard manager for iPhone and iPad. It keeps useful text, links, formatting and images close at hand without turning clipboard history into a complicated, mouse-first workflow.

Use Clipman locally without creating an account, or connect to an optional self-hosted Clipman Server to share encrypted clipboard history between your iPhone and iPad.

Additional Details:

From the App Store:

Featured in Apple's "New Games We Love". Now with the Daily Three: the same three fights for everyone, one attempt a day. Offline, ad-free, one purchase.

The city runs on cards. Time to make your name.

Cyphr City is a cyberpunk card RPG where poker is combat and the whole city is up for grabs. Play cards onto a 5×5 board, build poker hands (pairs, straights, flushes, full houses, and the rare royal flush) and turn every hand into damage. Both hands are face-up, so every card is a chess move: read the board, block their line, and drop the 5th card to steal a hand right out from under them.

Additional Details:

From the App Store:

Connect dots. Outthink the bot. Challenge a friend. Try Magic bonuses, race the clock in Rush, or sharpen your tactics in Practice.

Every move changes the match. Connect dots, outthink the bot, or challenge a friend in tactical soccer.

Move the ball between adjacent dots and plan around routes that have already been used. Reach one of your opponent's three goal dots to score. Put the ball in your own goal and the other side gets the goal.

Additional Details:

From the App Store:

Match-3 on the screen of an old terminal. Fully playable with VoiceOver, every tile and every move is spoken. No ads, no lives, no timer. Nothing you buy helps you play.

Final Fortress is a match-3 puzzle. The whole game is the screen of an old terminal: green text, one cursor, and you, the commandant of the last fortress.

It is a quiet game. A working console in the dark, the hum of the systems, static like rain. A watch takes fifteen or twenty minutes: do the day's tasks, read what came in, hand over. Nothing hurries you, and nothing happens while you are away. Come back after a week and the fortress is exactly as you left it.

Additional Details:

From the App Store:

GameBoard is a premier, audio-first multiplayer gaming platform designed to bring players together through classic card and board games. Crafted with universal accessibility in mind, GameBoard is 100% compatible with native mobile screen readers like VoiceOver, while offering a visually stunning, responsive interface for all players. Play Ludo, Mile by Mile, Farkle, Citadels, and more with friends or competitors worldwide. Whether you play by sight, sound, or touch, GameBoard provides an equal, inclusive, and exciting competitive environment.

Additional Details:

From the App Store:

Bring your manuscript to life. Organize chapters, track your writing, and compile Markdown files into books, documents, presentations, and braille.

ghostWriter Markdown is an accessibility-first, plain-text writing app for notes, articles, documentation, and full manuscripts. Write individual documents, organize chapters, and compile your work into a finished export.

VoiceOver was at the center of the design from the first line of code. Created by a blind developer, ghostWriter gives screen reader users and anyone who loves plain text a clean, native place to write.

Additional Details:

What happens when you take classic Hangman and turn up the pressure? You get Hangman Blitz, the classic word-guessing game, reimagined. Classic Hangman The game you know and love. Guess the hidden word one letter at a time, but choose carefully, you don't want to complete the figure. Timed Hangman Think you've mastered Classic? Unlock Timed Hangman and try it with a two-minute clock counting down. Guess the word before the figure is completed, or before the clock hits zero. Blitz Mode Now go all-out. The hangman figure is gone, the clock is ticking, and your goal is simple: guess as many words as you can before time runs out. Correct letters add precious seconds; mistakes take them away. Work your way through Starter, Rapid, and Extreme Blitz, where the clock gets shorter and the penalties get tougher.

Build holdings, upgrade to Manors, and win by Harmony Points. Accessible design, haptics, and concise announcements included.

Honeywood is a cozy, competitive strategy board game where you build a kingdom, grow your economy, and race to 1000 Harmony Points. Buy holdings, upgrade with buildings, and outplay your opponent through smart timing and resource control.

Additional Details:

From the App Store:

Build an automated solar empire from a single bot into a galaxy-spanning Dyson swarm.

Create bots, manufacture solar panels, harness stars for energy, and reinvest your profits into an ever-growing production network.

Additional Details:

Intersector helps you quickly identify nearby street intersections using your iPhone’s location and heading.

Ask for the nearest intersection, what’s coming up ahead, use Scan Mode to point your phone down the street and hear the intersection it detects, or turn on Live Mode and have Intersector speak your upcoming intersections on a walk or during a ride with your phone locked.

Muse is your personal AI agent that gets things done, always working on what matters to you. It manages email, books dinners, tracks budgets, and finds deals, with your approval.

Additional Details:

Unpack fifty years of family memories. Every object knows where it belongs. Find its place, feel it settle, and watch the house fill with stories. No timers, no pressure.

Nana's House is a quiet game about unpacking a family's memories, one room at a time. Each chapter opens a new box in a new room: a kitchen, a bathroom, a garden, a paint room, and more, each scene built carefully to hold its own place in the family's story. No timers. No scores. Additional Details:

One sentence a day. One book at the end of the year. Your life is happening — quietly, quickly, in small moments. One Line, One Year captures 2026 as it unfolds and turns it into a beautifully structured book that's entirely yours.

Additional Details:

Additional Details:

Take an order, head to the kitchen, and prepare a growing variety of food through clear, hands-on interactions. Make sure you choose the right ingredients, pay attention to the cooking time, serve each item when it is ready, and try not to let it burn.

Additional Details:

Unlock a new realm of productivity and creativity on your iPhone and iPad with Private LLM, the premier AI assistant designed with your privacy in mind. Available for a one-time purchase, it offers a range of AI capabilities without needing a subscription. Experience advanced on-device AI that keeps your interactions confidential and offline.

Additional Details:

RealTime AI Cam tells you what your camera is pointed at, out loud. Every part of it runs on the phone, so it works in airplane mode, on a subway, or in another country with no data. No account, no subscription, nothing to buy.

Additional Details:

Harness the power of born-accessible remote desktop, right in the palm of your hand!

Remote Incident Manager’s mobile companion turns your iPhone or iPad into a powerful universal remote for any PC or Mac running Remote Incident Manager, opening up a world of possibilities.

Tap into your home computer while on your commute, and control it as if you were right there in front of it! Run full support or training sessions straight from your phone, complete with crystal-clear voice conversations. Perform routine maintenance on machines across fleets, anytime, anywhere!

Additional Details:

One purchase, everything included. No ads, no coins to buy, no timers. A cursed House, a thumb that runs out, and one more cell you probably shouldn't touch.

A scratch-card roguelike. You work the night counter of a House that sells luck sealed under foil. The quota is due by dawn. Miss it, and the House keeps you.

Every ticket is a grid of foil hiding cash, multipliers and skulls. Your thumb is the budget — stamina runs out long before the tickets do, so where you scratch matters as much as what's under it.

Additional Details:

Draft one item a round and watch your tree fight five rival ghosts. Blood Moon runs all October: deeper Bleed and Halloween rewards to earn. Free to play, no ads.

Six trees walk into the forest. One walks out.

Make sure it is yours.

Additional Details:

Verbena — a cozy word roguelike.

Spell words. Grow your garden. Chase the bloom.

Verbena blends the calm of a cozy garden with the moreish "just one more run"

Additional Details:

From the App Store:

VoiceGammon brings Portes — one of the three traditional Greek backgammon games — to everyone, with particular care for VoiceOver accessibility.

news.title: Lexo Offline AI Voice Keyboard
news.summary: Lexo is a private AI keyboard for Android. Voice typing and next-word prediction both run entirely on device, so once setup is done the keyboard…
news.body:
Published 1 October 2026 by Warren Carr

Lexo is a private AI keyboard for Android. Voice typing and next-word prediction both run entirely on device, so once setup is done the keyboard keeps working with no internet connection, in airplane mode, and anywhere the signal drops.

After installing, open Lexo once to switch it on. The app walks you through it: pick your language, turn Lexo on in Android’s keyboard settings, make it your keyboard, then try it out.

Cloud keyboards send what you type to a server and wait for the answer. Lexo puts the models on your phone instead: the typing model downloads once, plus the speech recognizer if you use voice, then they live in the app’s private storage. Nothing you type or say leaves the phone. No sign-up, no ads.

Lexo is a paid keyboard. Every install starts with a 30-day Premium trial covering everything the on-device models power: offline voice typing, next-word prediction, the suggestion strip and autocorrect, and glide typing.

After that those features stop until you buy Premium: a one-time purchase, not a subscription. Without Premium the keyboard still types: layouts, language switching, emoji, clipboard history, themes, one-handed mode and gestures. No ads either way.

Setup downloads the typing model for your language once, over Wi-Fi by default. Its size depends on the language. Voice typing downloads its own speech pack the first time you use the microphone, and each extra language adds its own. App updates do not re-download any of it.

Built on the open-source FlorisBoard project, with open-weight models: SmolLM2, Qwen2.5 and KB-Whisper (Apache-2.0), a Turkish GPT-2 fine-tune (MIT), Gemma (Gemma Terms of Use) and NVIDIA Parakeet (CC-BY-4.0).

Questions, bug reports, feature requests: reddit.com/r/lexokeyboard .

Free or paid:

Accessibility and User Comments:

Following the release of the Pixel 11-series that came onboard with “Rambler,” a new experience of voice typing, more and more Devs are coming up with creative methods of achieving the same experience for non-Pixel 11-series users. Thus, we’re here talking about “Lexo Keyboard,” a keyboard that works entirely offline once you download the model needed for offline use.

I spent a lot of time working with the Developer to make the app accessible, and I’m proud of this Developer for his work in ensuring that the keyboard is accessible.

Thus, the keyboard supports “lift-to-type” using TalkBack.

I put the keyboard to use on both my Galaxy S23+, running One UI 8.5 (Android 16), and my Pixel 11 Pro XL, running Android 17. The voice dictation works similarly across the two devices.

What is worth mentioning, however, is that in order to be able to double-tap anywhere on the phone to stop voice dictation, you would have to go to TalkBack Settings > Advanced settings > Reduce delay > Typing preference and choose “Hold finger to select letter key, then lift. Double-tap for other keys.”

If you use “Hold finger to select any key, then lift” instead, you need to tap the voice input key directly to stop voice input, as tapping outside the keyboard area won’t stop it.

There are lots of settings on the keyboard that you can customize to your liking. Take advantage of those and customize the keyboard to your liking.

The app is available to anyone with access to the Play Store. When it comes to pricing, there’s a one-time payment of 10 bucks. Without the one-time payment, you can use the app with all features enabled for a period of 30 days.

After those 30 days, you wouldn’t have access to the premium features, but even as a free user outside of the 30-day free period, there are no ads.

You can listen to my Blind Android Users podcast audio demo of the keyboard Here

Last Tested App version and Android version:

2.0.37. Android 17

No accessibility ratings yet. Be the first to rate this app.

Rate accessibility only — not the app’s features, price, or overall quality.

Please log in to rate this app’s accessibility.
